children: Shell Plc Sponsored ADR (LSE:SHEL) is reshaping its portfolio—declaring a Q2 dividend and offering multi‑currency pay options, expanding power and gas positions with Hunlock Creek and a 30% Conifer stake, selling Rhode Island State Energy Center, and eyeing Jackdaw start-up amid strong fuel margins.
: Shell Plc Sponsored ADR (SHEL) declared Q2 2026 interim dividend US$0.3906 per share. Shareholders electing by Aug 28, 2026 may receive payment in USD, EUR (€0.3366) or GBP (28.92p).
: Shell (SHEL) holds 50% of Jackdaw gas field. UK approval delayed past Oct. 8 by-election into late autumn. If approved, Jackdaw could start in Q4 2026, >140,000 boe/d output.
: Shell Plc Sponsored ADR (SHEL) agreed to sell RISEC Holdings, owner of the 609 MW Rhode Island State Energy Center, to Constellation for $715 million; closing expected Q1 2027, pending approvals.
: Shell Plc ADR (SHEL) will buy a 30% stake in the Conifer Gulf of Mexico prospect from BP; BP stays operator with 70%. First exploration well slated to start drilling in 2027.
: Diesel and jet-fuel margins are elevated, likely aiding Shell Plc ADR (SHEL). Industry forecasts point to tightening fuel demand and supply; current SHEL valuation reflects high expected strength.
: SHEL: Shell Energy North America will buy Hunlock Creek, a 169 MW gas plant in Pennsylvania to expand in PJM wholesale power. Terms undisclosed; closing expected in Q1, pending approvals.
